tool.name: RFEM MC Aggregator
tool.description: Aggregate results from multiple RFEM instances (QoI extraction + Stats)
tool.command: export MPLBACKEND=Agg && export HOME=/tmp && python '$__tool_directory__/gdps_rfemmc_collect.py' --d_file '$d_file' #for $input in $res_collection --res_file '$input.element_identifier' '$input' #end for #for $input in $ensi_collection --ensi_file '$input.element_identifier' '$input' #end for --output_csv '$output_csv' --output_json '$output_json' --output_png '$output_png'

param.name: d_file
param.label: Shared Mesh geometry (.d)
param.help: Original mesh used for node coordinates

tool.help:
Aggregates results from a Monte Carlo ensemble of RFEM instances.
Inputs: - Shared Mesh geometry (.d): Used to identify boundary nodes and calculate flux. - Collection of .res files: Convergence information for each instance. - Collection of EnSight archives: Nodal potential/concentration fields for each instance.
Outputs: - MC Summary (CSV): Per-instance Quantity of Interest (downstream flux) and iteration count. - MC Statistics (JSON): Aggregate mean, standard deviation, and range. - MC Histogram (PNG): Visualization of the flux distribution.
Flux extraction: The tool calculates the average concentration at the first layer of interior nodes and divides by the element thickness (dz) to get a proxy for the downstream flux (J).
